row.title: CODE-REGULATOR-1 algedonic preempt, stable prefix check, PostToolUse token feed
row.body: Adds P9 debounced preempt channels, P11 prefix stability check and the hook that feeds the experiment 1 token ledger. Ran 16 regulator tests, they pass. The token counts are estimates (characters divided by 4), so the ledger gives shares by tool kind, not billing. Still a hypothesis that this lowers cost; threshold is the 15 percent cut set in the first lesson.
